import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
from collections import Counter
import os
import re

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_test_2.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_sample_submission_2.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission shape: {sample_sub.shape}")

# Create ID column for train
train_df["id"] = (
    train_df["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + train_df["token_id"].astype(str)
)

# Merge train with sample submission ids to ensure we have all test IDs covered
test_ids = test_df["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + test_df["token_id"].astype(str)
test_df["id"] = test_ids


# Feature extraction function
def extract_features(before_text, class_name=None):
    """Extract features from before text"""
    features = {}

    # Basic features
    features["length"] = len(before_text)
    features["num_digits"] = sum(c.isdigit() for c in before_text)
    features["num_letters"] = sum(c.isalpha() for c in before_text)
    features["num_punct"] = sum(1 for c in before_text if c in ".,;:!?\"'()-–—")
    features["has_digit"] = int(any(c.isdigit() for c in before_text))
    features["has_letter"] = int(any(c.isalpha() for c in before_text))
    features["is_upper"] = int(len(before_text) > 0 and before_text[0].isupper())
    features["starts_with_digit"] = int(
        len(before_text) > 0 and before_text[0].isdigit()
    )

    # Pattern features
    features["contains_space"] = int(" " in before_text)
    features["all_digits"] = int(before_text.isdigit()) if len(before_text) > 0 else 0
    features["all_letters"] = int(before_text.isalpha()) if len(before_text) > 0 else 0

    # Decimal/number detection
    if "." in before_text:
        parts = before_text.split(".")
        features["has_decimal_point"] = 1
        features["decimal_parts_count"] = len(parts)
    else:
        features["has_decimal_point"] = 0
        features["decimal_parts_count"] = 0

    # Class encoding
    if class_name:
        class_map = {
            "PLAIN": 0,
            "PUNCT": 1,
            "CARDINAL": 2,
            "ORDINAL": 3,
            "LETTERS": 4,
            "MEASURE": 5,
            "WEIGHT": 6,
            "DATE": 7,
            "TIME": 8,
            "PHONE": 9,
            "CURRENCY": 10,
            "ADDRESS": 11,
            "PERCENT": 12,
            "MISC": 13,
            "EMAIL": 14,
        }
        features["class_encoded"] = class_map.get(class_name, -1)
    else:
        features["class_encoded"] = -1

    return features


# Prepare training features
print("Extracting features...")
X_features = []
y_labels = []
ids_list = []

for idx, row in train_df.iterrows():
    feat = extract_features(row["before"], row["class"])
    X_features.append(feat)
    y_labels.append(row["after"])
    ids_list.append(row["id"])

X_train_full = pd.DataFrame(X_features)
y_train_full = np.array(y_labels)

# Split for validation
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

print(f"Train size: {len(X_train)}, Val size: {len(X_val)}")

# Train LightGBM classifier
feature_cols = X_train.columns.tolist()
print(f"Using features: {feature_cols}")

lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train, feature_name=feature_cols)
lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(
    X_val, label=y_val, feature_name=feature_cols, reference=lgb_train
)

params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": len(np.unique(y_train_full)),
    "metric": "multi_logloss",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.9,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

print("Training model...")
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[lgb_val],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

# Make predictions on validation set
print("Predicting on validation...")
val_pred = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
val_preds = [list(val_pred[i]).index(max(val_pred[i])) for i in range(len(val_pred))]

# Map back to original classes
unique_classes = np.unique(y_train_full)
val_predictions = unique_classes[val_preds]

# Calculate accuracy
accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_predictions)
print(f"\nValidation Accuracy: {accuracy:.4f}")

# Prepare test predictions
print("Preparing test predictions...")
test_features = []
for idx, row in test_df.iterrows():
    feat = extract_features(row["before"], None)  # No class info for test
    test_features.append(feat)

X_test = pd.DataFrame(test_features, columns=feature_cols)

print("Predicting on test set...")
test_pred_probs = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
test_pred_indices = [
    list(test_pred_probs[i]).index(max(test_pred_probs[i]))
    for i in range(len(test_pred_probs))
]
test_predictions = unique_classes[test_pred_indices]

# Create submission dataframe
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df["id"], "after": test_predictions})

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")

# Verify some predictions
print("\nFirst 10 predictions:")
for i in range(min(10, len(submission_df))):
    print(
        f"ID: {submission_df.iloc[i]['id']}, Predicted: {submission_df.iloc[i]['after']}"
    )
